note: Every threshold of the Set & Forget engine that can be tested. origin: 'source' = stated in the videos the strategy comes from; 'research' = our own number, to be measured, never attributed to the author; 'baseline' = the value the app ran before v2.4; 'owner' = the owner's explicit rule. 'grid' is the finite, pre-registered list of values an experiment may try (on the training period only).

min_touches.what: independent confirmed reactions an area of interest needs

zone_atr_k.what: zone thickness = k x ATR 14 (D1), in the pair's own price units

touch_reversal_atr.what: a touch is confirmed when price leaves the zone by this many ATR 14 (D1)

touch_sep_bars.what: candles between two touches: one visit never counts twice

h4_fallback.what: when W1 / D1 give no valid three-touch zone inside the active range, look for one on H4 (the gold example)

h4_aoi_bars.what: H4 candles the fallback zones are built from

min_rr.what: minimum reward / risk to the next opposing structure; the videos speak of 1:3 to 1:4 as a wish, not a rule

counter_min_gpa.what: a counter-trend setup (SF_COUNTER) needs this GPA; trend-following setups need 70

break_even.what: move the stop to the entry + 2 pips at +1.5R; off: the stop saved with the signal never moves (the owner, 2026-11-11)

validation.validated_when: at least 100 out-of-sample trades (validation + test) on the instrument AND the 95 % bootstrap interval of its net expectancy is above 0 R
